answer_1.quote: Framing verdict production as a summarization task over fact-checking articles is a suitable solution due to the possibility of generating highly readable verdicts even for non-expert users.
answer_1.outputs: generated verdicts explaining why a claim is true or false

answer_2.quote: We use ROUGE-LSum, BARTScore, and SummaC to evaluate lexical adherence and faithfulness of the generated text to the context provided to the LLM.

answer_4.quote: Therefore, we also provide a comprehensive human evaluation of the generated verdicts. We enlisted three expert evaluators...
answer_4.guideline: Tell which of the two verdicts contains more information supporting its stance. Emotional Coverage: Tell which of the two verdicts better takes into consideration the emotion of the claim by responding with empathy. Which of the two is an overall better verdict (with respect to the claim) that could be used to answer the claim?
